verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim every response includes citations traceable to the original source, and search results link to peer-reviewed papers with full-text analysis. However, there is no independent/hands-on verification of citation accuracy or completeness, and no detail on how consistently citations map to specific substantive claims (e.g., per-sentence attribution vs. general source list). Missing for 10: independent verification of citation fidelity, evidence of per-claim (not just per-response) sourcing, and third-party audits of citation accuracy.
